description: A reviewed, model-generated expression change in the real RetryBudget.cs source file, built and executed only inside the existing offline MicroVM production verifier.
acceptanceCriteria: Only the RetryBudget.HasAnotherAttempt expression may change in a detached production worktree.
The host-owned RetryBudget fixture, project and 268 boundary tests remain immutable.
A fresh isolated MicroVM verifies every generated candidate. No model code runs on the host.
The original main checkout must remain unmodified; no automatic commit, PR or merge.
